no_adcom_quote.quote: An advisory committee was not convened because there were no issues raised in the course of the NDA review that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA 209570 (benznidazole for Chagas disease). The Summary Review states an advisory committee was not convened because no issues raised during the NDA review would have benefited from AC discussion, and the Medical Review confirms no AC meeting was held. Because no AdComm occurred, there are no AC-driven linkages to the approval.
